name: first-server-prisma
description: The same first server, talking to the database through Prisma instead of raw SQL.
comment: Prisma versions are pinned EXACTLY, not with ^. npm's `latest` tag for the prisma CLI currently points at a v8 release candidate whose commands differ (db push became db update), and `latest` for @prisma/client points at 7.x — so an unpinned install gets a mismatched pair and fails on the first command. The pin also keeps the engine mirror valid, since the engine hash is per version.
